judgments.reason: The span 'SARS-CoV-2 PCR: initially positive, negative after 3 weeks' appears literally in the laboratory tests section and confirms prior SARS-CoV-2 infection, clinically supporting the post-SARS-CoV-2 etiology of the reactive arthritis.
